{"text":"§6§lSpark & Strike§r
§8Blacksmith's Manual§r

§0Welcome to physical in-world smithing.

Forget 2D menus. Craft an §1Artisan Anvil§0 and §1Forging Hammer§0 to shape metal directly in the world."}

{"text":"§6§lCrafting Blueprints§r

§0Before shaping steel, draft a Blueprint at a Crafting Table:

• §1Sword Blueprint§0 (Paper, Ingot, Stick)
• §1Pickaxe Blueprint§0 (Paper, 3 Ingots, 2 Sticks)
• §1Axe Blueprint§0 (Paper, 3 Ingots, 2 Sticks)"}

{"text":"§6§lFeeding Materials§r

§01. Right-click the anvil with a Blueprint to lay it flat.

2. Feed workpiece items in sequence by right-clicking.

Watch your §2action bar§0 for real-time loading feedback."}

{"text":"§6§lMistake Correction§r

§0Inserted the wrong material?

• §1Empty hand right-click§0: pops the last staged item back.

• §1Sneak + right-click§0: pops the Blueprint and all items back."}
